result.title: Multi-Scale Latent Temporal Compression Attention and Video-Text Cross Attention Fusion for Video Action Detection
result.comment: This paper has been accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 33rd International Conference on Multimedia Modeling (MMM 2027)
result.summary: In video action detection, modeling the temporal dependencies in continuous video streams is crucial. Previous methods based on deep neural networks can perform frame-level video recognition tasks. However, these methods struggle to model dynamic temporal patterns, facing challenges such as redundant frame information, difficulty balancing global and local features, and insufficient fusion of visual and textual features. To address these issues, we propose a video temporal attention module based on the Multi-Scale Latent Temporal Compression Attention, which aggregates continuous temporal sequences into feature representations across diverse temporal scales while efficiently reducing redundancy. We also introduce a Video-Text Cross Attention Fusion module that leverages cross-attention at both latent and standard feature levels, achieving fine-grained fusion between video and textual features to enhance semantic alignment and feature interaction. Experimental results across multiple video recognition benchmarks demonstrate that our proposed methods achieve superior performance compared to existing methods, validating the effectiveness and generalization capability.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向视频动作检测，提出多尺度潜在时间压缩注意力以聚合连续时序特征并降低帧冗余，并用视频—文本交叉注意力在潜在层与标准特征层做细粒度融合，在多个视频识别基准上验证性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 「latent」在此仅指压缩后的视频特征空间，无推理状态生成、证据筛选、停止决策或答案对 latent 的使用等主线要素，属一般视频任务应用，未见可供核查的具体借鉴线索。
